_source_documentation.product_name: GHRSST Level 4 MUR Global Foundation Sea Surface Temperature Analysis
_source_documentation.issuing_agency: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) Physical Oceanography DAAC (PO.DAAC)
_source_documentation.access_notes: GHRSST MUR L4 data is publicly accessible via NASA EarthData OPeNDAP after free registration at urs.earthdata.nasa.gov. A real NetCDF binary is not committed to this repository due to file size. This metadata JSON documents the product specification. The satellite_importer.py adapter accepts actual GHRSST NetCDF files placed at this path. External blocker: EarthData registration required for automated download.

pilot_region_subset.description: North Arabian Sea — Maharashtra/Konkan coast pilot region

scale_factor_note: xarray applies scale_factor (0.001) and add_offset (298.15) automatically when opening with engine='netcdf4'. After scaling, analysed_sst is in Kelvin. Convert to Celsius by subtracting 273.15.
quality_mask_interpretation: Mask bit 0 (open_sea) indicates valid ocean pixels. Non-zero mask values indicate non-ocean pixels and must be treated as missing/invalid, NOT coerced to 0.

nominal_sst_range_celsius.note: Typical Arabian Sea SST range for September

citation: JPL MUR MEaSUREs Project. 2015. GHRSST Level 4 MUR Global Foundation Sea Surface Temperature Analysis (v4.1). Ver. 4.1. PO.DAAC, CA, USA. Dataset accessed [2026-09-12] at https://doi.org/10.5067/GHGMR-4FJ04
import_instructions: Place actual GHRSST MUR NetCDF file at data/source_snapshots/mosdac/20260912090000-JPL-L4_GHRSST-SSTfnd-MUR-GLOB-v02.0-fv04.1.nc and run SatelliteImporter with product_spec='GHRSST_MUR'
